procedure: Record current deployed commit and verify the UI smoke path
Deploy a previously reviewed commit or stop the current app
Verify the app is unavailable or shows the expected previous build
Restore the reviewed commit and reboot the app
Verify UI, dependency startup, audit logs, and safety flags
success_criteria: Rollback and restore are completed without data loss
App returns to a known reviewed commit
No production weights, verdicts, or trades are mutated

rules: Secrets stay in the platform secret store and never in Git or reports
Use least privilege and documented rotation/revocation
Encrypt memory bundles at rest and record key identifiers, not key values
Log access and restore events without logging secret material
Test recovery with a non-production fixture before any production use
